gameDescriptionHtml:
The A.V.A.F (anti-vandal-attack-force) is planning to wipe away the graffiti that coats the city streets. This municipal force won’t hesitate to flush out any filth, along with your new crew. It’s time to make a mess.

TAGLINE is a lightning fast graffiti-based platformer with a unique weapon swapping mechanic: Switch powers on the fly by snatching tags off the walls of a funky-futurist metropolis!

Help a cast of hand animated characters fight back against the A.V.A.F by taking on challenges across open level city districts. Compete assorted score based challenges to prove yourself and upgrade your skills!

Game Features

  • A retro FPS with a new style: Funky 2D animations and particles clash with an oppressive 3D world, while deep mechanics and fluid movement bring a fresh feel to the genre.
  • No nonsense gameplay: Quick switch powers on the fly without worrying about ammo, simple controls mean TAGLINE is easy to learn and difficult to master!
  • The Sky is the Limit: Progress through a handcrafted world featuring open playgrounds, each with their own missions and secrets to discover!
  • 5 powerful skills: Ride explosions, scale buildings, and fly through the air with 5 unique abilities. Each with their own upgrades, dynamic uses, and synergies!
  • Fill your black book: Hunt down 100+ unique graffiti designs and chronicle the history of the TAGGERS, a group of street artists lost to time.
